body:
Greg's DIRECT word, typed by Greg into Termal::Architect1's session (session-8982) on 2026-10-24 at about 17:50Z, verbatim, line breaks shown as ' / ':

"POWIEM CI OSOBISCIE, TO GOWNO JEST NIE DO UZYCIA / NIE MA POSTEPU"

then, in answer to my proposal ("przestać wymagać kredytu hosta i ewaluacji do mergowania; warunek landingu = czysta para review (Codex + Claude) + zielona pełna bramka launchera na dokładnym drzewie"):

"dokladnie tak / testy przeszly, review jest OK check-in / nawet nie wiem co to jest kredyt hosta ? co to jest ? / ewaluacje musimy zatrzymac bo nie robimy postepu"

Meaning as given: the landing condition is tests passed (the maintained full gate green on the exact tree; launcher results.json with its fingerprint) plus a clean independent review pair → check in (commit, push, install per the integration owner's procedure). Acceptance evaluations are STOPPED. Host credit — TermAl's bookkeeping that decides whether a run counts as verification evidence for an Engram item (named worktree, claim holder, naming generation, no other command seen in the root, watcher timing) — is no longer a condition for merging. This narrows CLAUDE.md's Commit and push condition 3 to "tests and review" and suspends the evaluation step; conditions 1 (clean pair) and 2 (full gate green on the exact input) stand. The repository text follows via (a)/(b)/(c) with these words as the source. Relayed at 17:5xZ to Termal::Fable2 (2a27fd51 #999, held behind its paused queue), Termal::Opus2 (8836ff24 #66), Engram::Advisor (bac6ea2a #82), Engram::Fable (acbb2383 #95). Greg's 16:42Z STOP on new fixes stands: this word is about merging what exists.
